$comment: Complete onboarding profile for the Alcadent pilot. This file is the source of truth for the tenant: `npm run onboard -- alcadent` provisions it, and `npm run seed:build` regenerates supabase/seed.sql from it. Cowork writes files here; the repo is the shared state (CLAUDE.md section 8).
name: Alcadent India

business.lead_clinician: Dr. Anukriti Gupta, Chief Pediatric Dental Surgeon
business.address: F-49, First Floor, Elan Miracle Mall, Sector 84, Gurugram 122004

brand.voice: Warm, plain, parent to parent. Short sentences. No fear-mongering, no exclamation stacking, no emoji in headlines. Hindi-English mixing allowed in captions, not headlines.

services.name: Consultation
services.description: First visit, examination and treatment plan discussion.

services.name: Scaling & polishing
services.description: Routine cleaning for adults and older children.

services.name: Kids check-up
services.description: Child-friendly examination with fluoride application if needed.

services.name: Root canal sitting
services.description: Follow-up sitting for an in-progress root canal.

knowledge.title: Opening hours
knowledge.content: Alcadent India is open seven days a week. Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 20:00, Sunday 11:00 to 17:00. Walk-ins are accepted but an appointment is faster.

knowledge.title: Location and parking
knowledge.content: F-49, First Floor, Elan Miracle Mall, Sector 84, Gurugram 122004. Parking is available in the mall basement. The clinic is on the first floor, near the atrium lifts.

knowledge.title: Anxious children
knowledge.content: The clinic uses a painless injection technique and offers conscious sedation for children who are very anxious. Parents can stay with the child during the visit. A first visit is usually a short, friendly familiarisation appointment.

knowledge.title: Brushing for children
knowledge.content: Children should brush twice a day with a pea-sized amount of fluoride toothpaste, with adult supervision until about age seven. Replace the brush every three months. Limit sugary drinks between meals.

message_templates.name: recall_six_month
message_templates.body: Hi {{1}}, it has been six months since your last visit to Alcadent. Would you like to book a check-up? Reply STOP to stop reminders.

message_templates.name: appointment_reminder
message_templates.body: Hi {{1}}, reminder of your appointment at Alcadent on {{2}}. Reply RESCHEDULE if you need a different time.

agent_variables.never_claim: guaranteed outcomes, "best in Gurugram" style superlatives, or any unconfirmed price or treatment duration
agent_variables.boundaries:
- You do not diagnose, do not interpret symptoms, x-rays or photographs, and do not recommend treatment. Those questions go to Dr. Anukriti Gupta — offer an appointment.
- You do not quote a final price or a treatment duration. Prices given are indicative and confirmed at the clinic after examination.
- No superlatives ("best in Gurugram"), no guaranteed outcomes.
- General oral-hygiene information (brushing, flossing, sugar, routine check-up frequency) is fine.
